label: Ты бы
description: A 10-sentence card for the soft-suggestion frame Ты бы + past.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Soft suggestion frame. Ты бы plus the past позвонил proposes the call lightly, as a you might want to. The particle бы attaches to the past form, the only shape it joins, giving a nudge rather than an order.
Strategic focus: Gentle nudge to rest. The frame ты бы plus отдохнул suggests a break without insisting. Its advisory force is mild, closer to a friendly hint than a demand.
Strategic focus: Female addressee. The past form оделась shows the listener is female, since бы sits with a past verb that agrees in gender. The line softly advises dressing warmer.

missions.phrase: Ты бы спросил у него совета.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Suggesting to ask. Ты бы plus the past спросил recommends seeking his advice. The construction stays suggestive, presenting the idea as worth considering rather than required.

missions.phrase: Ты бы хоть поел перед дорогой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Mild reproach. The word хоть adds a touch of reproach, hinting the listener neglected to eat. Поел is past plus бы, so the gentle scolding still runs through the suggestion frame.
Strategic focus: Suggesting an apology. The frame ты бы plus извинился pushes softly toward making amends. The bare ты бы construction leaves the choice open while clearly recommending it.
Strategic focus: Reproach about the past. Лучше sharpens the hint that silence would have been wiser. Промолчал is the past form бы requires, and the line mixes mild reproof with advice.
Strategic focus: Encouraging enrollment. The feminine past записалась marks a female listener and proposes signing up for a course. The why-not tone comes from ты бы joined to that past form.

missions.phrase: Ты бы сходил к врачу наконец.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Overdue advice. Наконец signals the speaker thinks the visit is long due, lending a light reproach. Сходил carries бы, keeping the push gentle within the suggestion frame.

missions.phrase: Ты бы помог им с переездом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Suggesting help. Ты бы plus the past помог proposes lending a hand with the move. The frame reads as a soft why not, presenting the help as a welcome option.
